title: DAMI: Dual-Axis Memory Initialization for Enhanced Long-Context Retrieval in Gated Linear Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.41994v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Linear attention scales linearly with sequence length, but its finite-state memory can limit long-context retrieval. In gated linear recurrences, memory retention depends on state decay, which is shaped jointly by gate parameters A_log and dt_bias and by input activations. In controlled Gated DeltaNet (GDN) experiments, both parameters remain highly correlated with their initial values after training, highlighting the importance of initialization. Therefore, we introduce Dual-Axis Memory Initialization (DAMI), which jointly configures these parameters before training. DAMI assigns geometric timescales across heads for varied retrieval distances and a low-high-low input-sensitivity profile across layers. A small activation sample calibrates the GDN-family implementation to match both behavioral targets without adding trainable parameters. Across GDN, KDA, GDN2, Mamba-2, and RWKV-7, DAMI improves average RULER-style retrieval accuracy by

translated_title: DAMI：用于增强门控线性注意力长上下文检索的双轴记忆初始化
translated_abstract: 线性注意力随序列长度呈线性扩展，但其有限状态记忆可能限制长上下文检索能力。在门控线性递归中，记忆保持取决于状态衰减，而状态衰减由门控参数 A_log 和 dt_bias 以及输入激活共同决定。在受控的 Gated DeltaNet（GDN）实验中，这两个参数在训练结束后仍与其初始值高度相关，凸显了初始化的重要性。因此，我们提出了双轴记忆初始化（DAMI），在训练前联合配置这些参数。DAMI 在各个头（head）之间分配几何时间尺度以覆盖不同的检索距离，并在各层之间采用低-高-低的输入敏感度分布。仅需一个小型激活样本即可校准 GDN 系列的实现，以匹配这两个行为目标，且不增加任何可训练参数。在 GDN、KDA、GDN2、Mamba-2 和 RWKV-7 等模型上，DAMI 将平均 RULER 风格检索准确率提升了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出双轴记忆初始化方法 DAMI，通过在训练前为门控线性注意力中的各注意力头分配几何时间尺度、并为各层设置低-高-低的输入敏感度分布，在不增加可训练参数的前提下显著提升了 GDN、KDA、Mamba-2、RWKV-7 等模型的长上下文检索准确率。
en_tdlr: DAMI is a parameter-free initialization method that jointly configures geometric timescales across heads and a low-high-low input-sensitivity profile across layers in gated linear attention, significantly improving long-context retrieval accuracy on GDN, KDA, GDN2, Mamba-2, and RWKV-7 without adding trainable parameters.
